channel.title: US Top News and Analysis
channel.description: CNBC is the world leader in business news and real-time financial market coverage. Find fast, actionable information.

item.title: Satya Nadella reinvented Microsoft once. Can he do it again in the AI era?
item.description: After succeeding Steve Ballmer in 2014, Satya Nadella turned Microsoft into a cloud giant. Now he's tasked with making the company a force in AI.

item.title: GM says hybrid vehicles are coming: 'We're not tone deaf to our customers'
item.description: Hybrids are growing in popularity, as sales of the vehicles keep climbing.

item.title: Treasury yields rise to start the week; traders look ahead to Fed minutes
item.description: U.S. Treasury yields are bouncing after a sharp decline. Investors are looking ahead now to the release of the minutes of the Federal Reserve's last meeting.

item.title: Nasdaq rises to fresh record high led by tech; traders eye oil and yields: Live updates
item.description: Stocks are coming off a week defined by surging Treasury yields and a surprisingly weak jobs report that helped ease concerns about another Fed rate hike.

item.title: David Ellison just brought in a co-CEO to run his new empire: Meet Ynon Kreiz
item.description: Ynon Kreiz's appointment as co-CEO of Skydance answers a key governance question for Ellison's soon-to-be-merged company.

item.title: Josh Brown takes a look at winners and losers on his Best Stocks list as Q4 begins
item.description: Josh Brown and Sean Russo take a look at four names that have made their Best Stocks in the Market list — two winners and two losers.

item.title: China shuts hundreds of banks as Beijing moves to shore up its financial system
item.description: Beijing shuttered 670 mainly rural banks last year in a bid to create fewer, larger and better-capitalized lenders.

item.title: Trump tells South Korea to sign on to Alaska LNG deal or 'I'll just charge them more'
item.description: Trump is ramping up pressure on South Korea over Alaska LNG as Seoul remains cautious over investment projects announced by the U.S. president.

item.title: David Ellison and Ynon Kreiz announce Skydance leadership team
item.description: The leadership team for Skydance, the merged entity of Paramount Skydance and Warner Bros. Discovery, will include Bari Weiss, Mark Thompson and Casey Bloys.

item.title: Cerebras stock pops 9% after Sam Altman calls the chipmaker a 'close partner'
item.description: Cerebras stock climbed in premarket trading after OpenAI's CEO Sam Altman reassured investors that the firm is a "close partner."

item.title: The 2029 tipping point: Western populations are about to start shrinking, piling pressure on public finances
item.description: Moody's predicts that the world's aging populations will have fundamental impacts on the global economy and lead to difficult policy decisions.

item.title: Russia plague: What we know about the suspected case reportedly linked to a lab worker’s death
item.description: According to local media reports, as many as 189 people have also been placed under medical observation in Irkutsk in Eastern Russia.

item.title: Nvidia's $6 trillion milestone looms. Here's when options traders see it happening
item.description: Nvidia will likely cross the $6 trillion threshold by the end of this month, according to options traders.

item.title: This 'premier' data center play has 30% upside ahead, says BMO
item.description: Data center demand will continue to push this digital infrastructure company higher, according to BMO Capital Markets.

item.title: Why airfares could rise even more, but airline profits won't
item.description: Airlines are trimming capacity as jet fuel prices keep climbing and travelers keep booking.

item.title: Three tax votes in November that will affect high earners
item.description: Voters will decide whether to raise or lower taxes on the wealthy in multiple states next month, with California leading the way with a potential wealth tax.

item.title: Surging Treasury yields don’t signal a U.S. 'fiscal apocalypse' — yet
item.description: Treasury yields above 5% are raising fears that higher borrowing costs could fuel a debt spiral.

item.title: Trump's nemesis in Europe: Why Spain's Sanchez is calling a snap election
item.description: Pedro Sánchez has been Europe's voice of dissent on U.S. foreign policy. Back home, the plight of an 87-year-old woman has ignited public anger.

item.title: All U.S. bombers leave UK air base on concerns of suspected terror plots; more tankers struck near Iran in the Middle East
item.description: Tehran's conditions include a halt to U.S. "acts of aggression," an end to the naval blockade and economic warfare, and the release of Iranian assets.

item.title: Cut spending to curb runaway borrowing costs, Goldman's Gutman tells governments
item.description: Goldman Sachs' Anthony Gutman said lower fiscal deficits are needed tackle surging bond yields.

item.title: Jim Cramer's top 10 things to watch in the stock market Monday
item.description: Microsoft and Wells Fargo landed upgrades, and there's some encouraging M&A activity.

item.title: CNBC Points Pro: Is it better to book travel directly or through a credit card issuer's portal?
item.description: Points expert Jason Stauffer helps a reader understand the trade-offs between booking travel directly or through a third-party site.

item.title: Bolsonaro beats expectations in Brazil presidential vote, will face Lula in runoff
item.description: Right-wing Brazilian Senator Flavio Bolsonaro will face leftist President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva in a runoff of the presidential election later this month.

item.title: Trump reiterates pledge to send $5,000 checks, and hands out smaller payments, as midterm elections loom
item.description: Trump renewed a $5,000 check pledge tied to Republican control of Congress as $500 ACA refunds go out and $90 Medicare rebates are scheduled.

item.title: Euro hits 17-month low as political uncertainty in Spain and France rattles markets
item.description: Political and fiscal concerns are mounting in two of the euro area's biggest economies.

item.title: Russia ramps up attacks on Kyiv infrastructure as U.S. makes fresh push for peace talks
item.description: Russia has pledged to intensify strikes on Kyiv and other Ukrainian cities after a drone attack damaged the capital’s key Northern Bridge over the weekend.

item.title: Saudi Aramco chief says replenishing global oil stockpiles could take two years
item.description: Saudi Aramco's CEO warned it could take up to two years to rebuild global oil inventories, saying the squeeze could worsen as the U.S.-Iran war continues.

item.title: Supreme Court Justice Alito said he's 'thought about' retirement as Senate control hangs in balance
item.description: The Senate could flip to Democrats after November's midterm election, jeopardizing a potential Supreme Court nomination by President Donald Trump.

item.title: Sports betting is increasingly the norm for Gen Z. Here’s why some financial and mental health experts are worried
item.description: Surveys show Gen Z increasingly views sports bets as a form of investment, and those who gamble too often face mental health risks.

item.title: Private capital is reshaping Hollywood moviemaking
item.description: As Hollywood's financing structures diversify, private capital is increasingly funding the big screen and changing the types of movies that are being made.
